title: lore-cli session handoff 2026-11-01: 0.15.0 cut prepared, #712 landed, dev ahead of main, tag and publish are the operator's
description:
Session-handoff record for the lore-cli worker, 2026-11-01, written at the leader's request after the #712 landing (DEC-158). Restore with opum-workflow:opum-handoff; the live tracker and repository outrank this note. Close it when the successor has reconciled it and filed its own handoff. It supersedes LCLI-783 (closed in the same change).

STATE (read by ref at write time, 2026-11-01 about 14:50Z). origin/dev == 6cb4dbb0 (the lore-cli#712 squash) plus this tracker PR (lore-cli#711) once it lands; origin/main == eb13ece3, unchanged since the 0.15.0 promotion, so dev is AHEAD of main by #712 and the tracker commits and is NOT promoted: the leader sequences the dev to main promotion, then the tag goes on the NEW main commit, not eb13ece3. No tag v0.15.0 exists, and no registry step has been taken. Landed this session: lore-cli#702 (0.14.2 bumped to 0.15.0 per the ODOC-556 semver ruling, squash eb13ece3, Opus APPROVE at ea7ca086), #708, #710, and #712 (LCLI-784, squash 6cb4dbb0, Opus APPROVE at ada4d738 after a round-1 REQUEST_CHANGES). Main CI on eb13ece3 (run 41276839527): 13 jobs success, 1 skipped by design, 1 red = the macOS wedge (LCLI-760, job 124760620187), accepted by the leader, not re-run.

LCLI-775 (the 0.15.0 cut) is OPEN. AC0 (publish route) and AC1 (promoted to main, matrix read by ref) are ticked with open notes; the rest are not. Route: scripts/publish-release.sh from the operator's machine, Keychain service npm-opum-ai-publish (created 2026-09-14, granular token, 90-day cap; expiry is only provable by the script's own preflight). OIDC cannot authenticate (LCLI-482 open; no attestations on 0.14.1). The cut sequence is in the report to the leader and in the runbook "3. Cut a release": (0) rehearsal dispatch publish=false on main; (b) annotated tag v0.15.0 on the new main commit, then the opum-marketplace message (tag object SHA, peeled commit, skills/ tree SHA; skills/ MOVED since v0.14.1, tree 060393c9 to a64e795e at eb13ece3, so their pin bump must carry the new baseline and a lore schema export under 0.15.0); (c) publish=false dispatch on the tag with launcher_rc=1; (d) opum-cli-e2e lands receipts/lore/0.15.0.json, then publish-release.sh 0.15.0 <run-id> --dry-run, then for real (operator dialog); (e) opum-cli-e2e pair receipt, then quest latest first, then promote-latest.mjs --dry-run and --promote (operator dialog). Tag, push of the tag, every publish and the latest move are the operator's own dialog (tier 3): never mine. Do not tag, dispatch for real or publish until the leader sequences it.

WHAT STEP 0 TAUGHT. The release.yml probe needs quest at the declared version installable at DISPATCH time; quest 0.15.0 was neither on npm nor staged (run 41314948217: six legs failed at setup-quest, notarget). Quest-first staging is circular (quest staging needs the e2e quest receipt, whose pair lock needs a lore binary from a lore release run, which fails at the probe). So LCLI-784 reinstated a release.yml QUEST_SOURCE_REF pin at quest-cli main f86d343c (ci.yml keeps its own at 81645e55; they may differ). Rehearsal on that head, run 41315886296: four non-Windows probe legs pass with the 0.14.1 exit-6 line (out-of-date .codex/skills/lore/SKILL.md), both Windows legs fail only at setup-quest's Windows refusal, and promote-latest.mjs evaluateWindowsProbeExcuse, called with the real readers (defaultRun, gh api, npm view; mirror main() around line 1597), returned excused true; on the all-red run 41314948217 it returned excused false. The TAG run (c) must reproduce that shape, and that call must be re-run on it before promote-latest, because the rehearsal cannot be the --release-run (checkReleaseRun needs head_sha equal to the tag's commit). The probe job names still read fresh build accepts [targets] on purpose (promote-latest.mjs line 730 pins them).

OPEN WORK. LCLI-781: remove BOTH QUEST_SOURCE_REF pins (ci.yml 81645e55, release.yml f86d343c) and their tests once quest 0.15.0 is on npm latest; scope notes added (ADR-0023 amendment header should name LCLI-784, npm should read npm latest, and the pin tests do not pin where the ref is consumed). Spell opum-ai/quest-cli#709 when touching the ADR line and the ci.yml comment. LCLI-782: DEC-249 agents protected-classification implementation and ADR, waits for a brief AFTER the pair ships. LCLI-760: macOS wedge, third consecutive main-push wedge recorded, status unchanged. LCLI-646: the held agent-profile-capacity warning-to-error flip; 0d568f0f is already in v0.13.0, v0.14.0 and v0.14.1, so it may be due; the leader is raising it with opum-doc as its own item, NOT part of this cut. LCLI-776 (bun runtime wedge) carried.

FACTS THAT COST TIME. Locally the quest binary is 0.14.1, so lore check refuses (pair lock) and 3 tests in the real-quest unlink file fail; CI supplies quest, and they pass there. The ubuntu CI leg can hit the Bun epoll race (tracker-only PR #711 hit it; a reachability check then gh run rerun --failed settled it). A composed git push, shell-built paths in arguments, and a literal backtick are refused by hooks: push alone, and drive long quest edits from a python script run with python3 -I. zsh expands echo == so quote it. Keep the review worktrees (DEC-208): review-702-5d54541, review-702b-ea7ca08, review-712-ee89422, review-712b-ada4d73. Read CI by FULL head SHA and require total 14 with 0 not completed, never a bare in_progress check.
